   Sports Tory Horton Week 7 Preview vs. the Chiefs
 Oct 24, 2026 Photo : Andrew Wevers / Getty Images Sport / Getty Images 
 Seattle Seahawks receiver Tory Horton will be up against a middle-of-the-pack pass defense in Week 7 (Sunday at 8:20 p.m. ET), versus the Kansas City Chiefs. The Chiefs are ranked 14th in terms of passing yards allowed, at 217.2 per game.
 Horton's stat line so far this season displays five catches for 67 yards and one score. He averages 22.3 yards per game, having been targeted nine times.
 Listen to the game on 96.5 The Fan 
 Horton vs. the Chiefs
 Horton vs the Chiefs (since 2021): No games
 Kansas City has not given up 100 or more receiving yards to an opposing player in the 2026 season.
 The Chiefs have surrendered a TD pass to four opposing players this year.
 No player has registered more than one TD reception against Kansas City on the season.
 The 217.2 passing yards per game given up by the Chiefs defense makes them the NFL's 14th-ranked pass defense.
 The Chiefs' defense ranks second in the NFL with four passing TDs conceded so far this season.
 Catch NFL action all year long on Fubo. 
 Horton Receiving Insights
 Horton has hit the over on his receiving yards prop in one of two games (50.0%).
 Horton has received 4.5% of his team's 198 passing attempts this season (nine targets).
 He averages 7.4 yards per target this season (67 yards on nine targets).
 Horton has had a touchdown catch in one of three games this season. He had only one TD in that game.
 He has scored one of his team's 16 offensive touchdowns this season (6.2%).
